title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING AND DELINEATING THE ABRA DE ILOG PORT ZONE UNDER THE ADMINISTRATIVE JURISDICTION OF THE PHILIPPINE PORTS AUTHORITY (PPA)

text.en:
The Abrade Ilog Port Zone, as delineated and established
above, is hereby placed under the administration of the Philippine Ports
Authority, which shall, consistent with the regional industrial plans of the
Government, implement a program for the proper zoning, planning,
development, and utilization of the port.

Other orders, proclamations, and issuances, or portions
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately after its publication
in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 7th day of AUG in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Nine.
glarin A. Leage
By the President:
5043
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
